sources.notes: Allows record_store with block_size=0 placeholders to record kv_cache_spec_kind and kv_cache_spec_sliding_window and preserves group spec metadata across reset_prefix_cache.
sources.limitations: Applies to V1 KV cache offloading event subscribers.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45453: Synchronize Disaggregated Decode KV Release Across Attention-TP Ranks via ReduceOp.MAX
sources.notes: Synchronizes DecodeTransferQueue.pop_transferred across attention-TP ranks using torch.distributed.all_reduce(op=ReduceOp.MAX) so deferred KV slots are freed on the exact same scheduler step.
sources.limitations: Active when tp_size > 1 and enable_dp_attention is False.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45439: Rust sglang-radix-tree Paused Insert Walk (WALK -> OVERLAP -> COMMIT -> TAIL) and Evicted Action Plumbing
sources.notes: Splits RadixTree insertion into WALK, OVERLAP, COMMIT, and TAIL phases and emits CacheAction::Evicted records for hierarchical cache controllers.
sources.limitations: Used by Rust-backed HiCache / RadixCache managers.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4378, #4756 & #4643: Intel XPU dma-buf GPUDirect RDMA, Ascend A5 memfd Host Transfer, and CUDA Context Preservation
sources.notes: Implements XpuPlatform::exportDmabuf + ibv_reg_dmabuf_mr with validateDmabufRange overflow checks and pooled USM rejection, Ascend mmap/memfd host segments with aclrtMemcpyBatch, and exact CUcontext save/restore in CudaPlatform::copy.
sources.limitations: Intel XPU dma-buf requires unpooled Level Zero allocations (EnableDeviceUsmAllocationPool=0).

sources.title: LMCache PR #5935: Speed Up gRPC proto_codec.py for Repeated Integer Fields via Bulk C-Level extend()
sources.notes: Uses getattr(message, field_name).extend(value) and list(getattr(message, field_name)) for repeated integer fields, accelerating 8K-token encode 3.38x (440 -> 130 us), decode 2.50x (450 -> 180 us), 32K lookup +102%, and KV events +121%.
sources.limitations: Applies to repeated integer scalar fields (INT32, INT64, UINT32, UINT64).

sources.title: Dynamo PR #16742 & #14264: Release Python GIL in FpmEventRelay / FpmDirectPublisher, Propagate W3C traceparent, and Guard Pre-Killed Sessions
sources.notes: Releases GIL via py.allow_threads around FpmEventRelay::new/shutdown and FpmDirectPublisher::publish, injects W3C traceparent in KvRouter, and rejects open_session when kill_session arrived first.
sources.limitations: Applies to Rust-Python PyO3 FPM and KvRouter bindings.

sources.title: NIXL PR #2479 & #2445: 64-Bit nixl.xfer_request_id, Atomic nixl.xfer_execution Counter, and V2 TraceBackend::pushContext
sources.notes: Assigns a 64-bit nixl.xfer_request_id per nixlXferReqH and increments nixl.xfer_execution only when postXferReq is accepted (leaving rejected reposts unnumbered), while adding V2 TraceBackend::pushContext.
sources.limitations: Requires NIXL trace backend enabled for span emission.

sources.title: Megatron-LM PR #8353, TransformerEngine PR #3680 & #3548, and TorchTitan PR #5394: GDN Dynamic Prefill CUDA Graph, JAX Triton mHC Sinkhorn Barrier & cuDNN KDA, and GradientClipper
sources.publisher: NVIDIA Megatron-LM, TransformerEngine & PyTorch TorchTitan Contributors
sources.notes: Enables GDN dynamic inference prefill CUDA Graph replay via single-update GDP (num_householder=1, chunk_size=64) with in-place padded chunk descriptors, fixes Triton mHC Sinkhorn backward shared-memory transpose race via tl.debug_barrier(), adds cuDNN KDA linear attention, and introduces TorchTitan GradientClipper.
sources.limitations: GDN prefill CUDA Graph requires static max padded chunk buffer allocation on the inference context.

sources.title: FlashInfer Experimental Qwen 3.5 Gated Attention Block for Rubin (sm_107) via Vendored cuDNN Frontend 1.32.0 FROST CuTe-DSL
sources.notes: Ships flashinfer.qwen_3_5_block for Rubin (sm_107, cc 10.7) BF16 (d_model=4096, num_qo_heads=32, num_kv_heads=2, head_dim=256) across 3 serving forms (prefill, extend, decode) by vendoring 103 cuDNN Frontend 1.32.0 (d8b0a7ed5) FROST CuTe-DSL files with zero cudnn runtime dependency.
sources.limitations: Targets Rubin sm_107 BF16 with fixed Qwen 3.5 head geometry.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6621: Split MoE All-to-All into flashinfer.moe_ep Dedicated Backends, Add DeepSeekFp8 Block-Scale Benchmark, and Fix GR100 (SM107) NVLink Build
sources.notes: Moves MoE all-to-all ops into flashinfer.moe_ep (NVLinkOneSidedAlltoAll, NVLinkTwoSidedAlltoAll, CakeAlltoAll), retires backend='trtllm', adds QuantFormat.DeepSeekFp8 (128-elem FP32 scale) to bench_moe_ep_comm.py, and fixes SM107 Mercury Validator failure via get_nvcc_flags_list().
sources.limitations: Retires legacy flashinfer.comm all-to-all namespace.

sources.title: FlashInfer PRs #6920, #6928 & #6927: Hoist TMA Encoders into cake_host_common.cuh and Ship Self-Contained Cake DeepGEMM Batched GEMM & FP8 1D1D GEMM Packages
sources.notes: Hoists 1D-4D CUtensorMap TMA descriptor encoders into cake_host_common.cuh (4d79be4100), and ships self-contained cake-build/1 packages for DeepGEMM batched GEMM (6 variants, 9.727-85.153 us on GB300) and FP8 1D1D GEMM (forward & wgrad accumulate, 5.504-95.137 us on GB300, 597e3a67ca).
sources.limitations: Targets Blackwell sm_100a (GB200) and sm_103a (GB300).

sources.title: FlashInfer PRs #6901 & #6902: Self-Contained Cake MLA K/V FP8 Pack (HG1-HG4) and Experimental NVFP4 Attention Packages
sources.notes: Re-exports cake_concat_mla_kv_quant_fp8 as 4 per-head-group self-contained unit pairs (HG1..HG4, 1.000x-1.004x geomean on GB300/GB200) and ships cake_nvfp4_attention on sm_103a (114.161-2837.625 us on GB300, edfb3f7f88).
sources.limitations: cake_nvfp4_attention currently ships non-causal persistent-tile variant on sm_103a only.

sources.title: SGLang PRs #45453 & #45439: Synchronize Deferred Decode KV Release Across Attention-TP Ranks and Thread cache_actions Through Radix Eviction Walk
sources.notes: Synchronizes failed transfer statuses across attention-TP ranks inside DecodeTransferQueue.pop_transferred (#45453) to prevent KV pool divergence under delay_kv_release, and threads cache_actions through BaseEvictionResult (#45439, 5e79333c95) draining _free_values before _apply_cache_actions.
sources.limitations: Requires TP-group collective status sync during decode transfer pop.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PR #19964: Standalone CPU trtllm-render CLI, /v1/chat/completions/render Endpoint, and SHA-256 Render Fingerprint Verification
sources.read_scope: tensorrt_llm/ commands and openai_server render endpoint
sources.notes: Adds standalone CPU-only trtllm-render and /v1/chat/completions/render returning token IDs, multimodal placeholder ranges, and render_fingerprint.digest, while excluding _GENERATION_CHANNEL_OPENER_TOKENS = 3 from Kimi-K3 prompt token accounting.
sources.limitations: Requires --trust-rendered-chat-template on the inference server to accept pre-rendered requests.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PRs #18547 & #20297: Fix Gemma-4 Startup on Non-SM100 GPUs via KVCacheLayerSpec and Floor Gen-Only Device-Step-Time Baselines
sources.notes: Replaces scalar num_heads_per_kv with KVCacheLayerSpec and max_num_heads_per_kv across layers to fix Gemma-4 startup on non-SM100 GPUs (#18547), and floors gen_only device-step-time history at GEN_ONLY_DEVICE_STEP_TIME_HISTORY_FLOOR_MS = 1790856543000 (#20297, 7f0caf443e).
sources.limitations: History floor remains active until the 90-day lookback window passes 2026-12-31.

sources.title: vLLM PRs #59703 & #62859: Preserve KV Offload Group Classification on Placeholder Events and Reject Multimodal Inputs in Chunked Embeddings
sources.notes: Retains static _group_specs across OffloadingEventsTracker.reset() so self-describing placeholder BlockStored events keep kv_cache_spec_kind ('mamba' / 'sliding_window') (#59703), and raises VLLMValidationError when multimodal prompts enter maybe_pre_process_chunked (#62859, 65a886c69f).
sources.limitations: Multimodal embeddings require enable_chunked_processing=False.

sources.title: LMCache PRs #5935 & #5805: Bulk-Extend Repeated Integer Fields in gRPC proto_codec and Add Multiprocess Plugin Extension Hooks
sources.notes: Replaces per-element Python int(x) comprehension with single-call C-extension getattr(message, field_name).extend(value) for repeated int32/int64/uint32/uint64 fields (#5935), and adds 5 multiprocess plugin hooks (#5805, 151c6c4f41).
sources.limitations: Applies to protobuf repeated integer wire types.

sources.title: Dynamo PRs #16742, #14264 & #13744: Release GIL During FPM Relay/Publisher Init, Preserve Request Context & Trace Spans Across Python Routers, and Add DGDR v1beta2 Carrier-Free Conversion
sources.notes: Releases Python GIL via py.allow_threads during FpmEventRelay::new and FpmDirectPublisher::new (4d31cd2f18, #16742), preserves child Context cancellation and W3C TraceContext spans across Python routers (#14264), and adds carrier-free lossless DGDR v1beta2 conversion with spec.v1beta1/v1beta2 mutual exclusion (7929f5370e, #13744).
sources.limitations: DGDR v1beta1 and v1beta2 envelope fields are mutually exclusive.

sources.title: NIXL PR #2477: Configurable DOCA Telemetry Source ID and Tag with Path-Separator Validation
sources.notes: Reads NIXL_TELEMETRY_DOCA_SOURCE_ID (defaulting to hostname instead of hardcoded 'nixl') and NIXL_TELEMETRY_DOCA_SOURCE_TAG (default 'nixl'), rejecting values containing '/' to protect DOCA data-file paths.
sources.limitations: First exporter created in a process sets the shared DocaSharedContext source identity.

sources.title: TransformerEngine PR #3680 & TorchTitan PR #5408: Integrating TE Triton mHC Kernels into JAX and Keeping Chunked-Loss Gradient Buffers in Native Dtype
sources.notes: Integrates 10 Triton mHC kernels into JAX with custom_vjp, SdyShardingRule, and 16B pointer alignment (53d1a3c71a, #3680), and keeps TorchTitan ChunkedLossWrapper GradAccumulator buffers in hidden_state.dtype (#5408), saving 128.0 MiB at 16K tokens and 1,043.983 MiB at 128K tokens on H100 80GB HBM3.
sources.limitations: JAX Triton global scratch requires JAX >= 0.11.1.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6626: Unified frost_low_latency MoE Backend on SM100/SM103/SM107 with Shared MX Weights Across TC128/TC256 and FMA Tactics
sources.notes: Replaces frost_bf16_moe and frost_mxfp4_moe with FrostLowLatencyConfig(max_num_tokens=2, range 1..8) on SM100/SM103/SM107, sharing prepared MXFP4/MXFP8 weights between TC128/TC256 (with PDL) and 16 scalar FMA warp-width tactics (top-k <= 32), supporting 10 typed BF16 activations, and achieving 1.794x BF16 (27.736->15.460 us) and 1.608x MX W4/T1 (21.616->13.440 us) speedups on B300.
sources.limitations: FMA tactics apply to top-k <= 32 and 1 <= max_num_tokens <= 8.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6939: cake_rmsnorm_train Row-Count Window Backward with Fixed-Order Tree dweight Reduction and Self-Resetting Flip Barrier
sources.notes: Upgrades H=1536 and H=4096 backward kernels on sm_100a/sm_103a/sm_107a to row-count window execution with fixed-order tree dweight reduction and a self-resetting flip barrier, plus sm_107a H=1536 bulk-copy producer/consumer forward above T=12288 (1.035x-1.079x fwd and 1.007x-1.134x bwd on R200).
sources.limitations: Targets H=1536 and H=4096 on sm_100a, sm_103a, and sm_107a.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6951: Stage Softmax Metadata One Step Ahead in cake_sage Block-Sparse Attention on SM100/SM103
sources.notes: Uses two previously idle warps to stage block metadata and per-16-token K scales into shared memory one step ahead (dynamic_smem_bytes 119040 -> 120320 B) on sm_100a/sm_103a with bit-identical O and LSE outputs, reaching 1.01x-1.08x speedup on B200 and 1.01x-1.03x on GB300.
sources.limitations: Updates SM100/SM103 attention forward kernel; SM120 specializations and quantizers are unchanged.

sources.title: FlashInfer PRs #6943 & #6949: Faster sm_107a Look-Back Chunk-Parallel Mamba2 SSD Programs and 18-Program Hopper sm_90a Variable Block-Sparse Attention Suite
sources.notes: Upgrades 6 sm_107a look-back chunk-parallel Mamba2 SSD programs (7601d0bb7e, #6943, 1.0215x call-level / 1.0839x main-kernel geomean on R200, up to 1.196x call / 1.268x main kernel) and ships 18 Hopper sm_90a VSA programs including a new compact static persistent program (#6949, up to 1.2624x on H100 SXM).
sources.limitations: cake_vsa_sm90 targets Hopper sm_90a HND BF16 head_dim=128 with 64-token blocks.

sources.title: vLLM PR #62767: Register FusedMMInputNorm Weight and Bias Buffers as persistent=False to Prevent DummyModelLoader Overwrite
sources.notes: Registers processor-derived weight = rescale_factor / std and bias = -mean / std with persistent=False so DummyModelLoader does not overwrite image normalization constants during --load-format dummy runs.
sources.limitations: Applies to processor-derived non-checkpoint normalization constants.

sources.title: vLLM PR #58509: ROCm HY-V4 Preview Performance Boost via Fused triton_ihc_post_pre_rms_norm, AiterMxfp8Experts SiLU Gate Mode, and MQA Logits Introspection
sources.notes: Fuses 5 IHC post/pre RMSNorm and residual stream steps into a single Triton kernel launch, enables MoEActivation.SILU and GELU on AiterMxfp8Experts with fused_moe_supports_gate_mode(), and guards deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits local-attention args via _accepts_parameters.
sources.limitations: Targets ROCm gfx942/gfx950 AITER execution paths.

sources.title: vLLM PR #60082: Add output_mode='derender' and ParseContext to Scale-Out /v1/generate
sources.notes: Emits ParseContext from /render and adds output_mode='derender' to /v1/generate so generate servers can parse tool calls and reasoning blocks directly via OnlineDerenderer, while allowing unknown ParseContext fields on non-derender legs.
sources.limitations: Does not support stream=True in derender mode or Rust frontend output_mode.

sources.title: vLLM PRs #62826 & #62823: Rust Frontend --custom-histogram-buckets Across 8 Metric Families and response_format Precedence Over structured_outputs
sources.notes: Adds --custom-histogram-buckets for 8 BucketFamily keys with strict positive increasing bound validation (#62826), and updates convert_from_response_format (18e8791134, #62823) so non-text response_format overrides same-kind structured_outputs constraints while rejecting conflicting kinds.
sources.limitations: Custom histogram buckets must be set before first family metric creation.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PR #19920 & SGLang PR #43039: Unify Offline Video Loader Cache Identity on VideoMediaIO (200 MiB Cap) and Initialize NPU Backend Before Parallel Runtime Resolution
sources.notes: Routes TRT-LLM offline load_video through VideoMediaIO with a 200 MiB (_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) cap so offline and serve paths produce identical raw_bytes_hash digests (#19920), and calls init_npu_backend() before _resolve_backend in SGLang init_parallel_runtime (2815eed49c, #43039).
sources.limitations: Enforces 200 MiB encoded video payload limit across offline and online loaders.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5807: Support MP Server Module Replacement via Subclassing and module_name Dependency Resolution
sources.notes: Adds module_name ClassVar to built-in MP server modules and keys order_modules and ModuleBuildContext.require by module_name so subclasses can replace built-in modules without breaking downstream dependency lookup.
sources.limitations: Replacement modules must declare or inherit a matching module_name.

sources.title: Dynamo PRs #16965 & #16750: Split Streaming Tool-Call Opener at </think> Reasoning End and Allocate Contiguous KV Replay Ports per DP Rank
sources.notes: Fixes extract_content_ids to split token chunks at reasoning_end_id (</think>) so trailing <tool_call> openers in the same chunk are parsed (#16965), and allocates contiguous DYN_VLLM_KV_REPLAY_PORT ranges across dp_size ranks (39ea07ea10, #16750).
sources.limitations: Requires reasoning_end_id to be configured on the reasoning parser.

sources.title: NIXL PRs #2408 & #2445: Share One prometheus_mp Scrape Endpoint per Process and Introduce Null-Safe nixl_getenv
sources.notes: Shares a process-wide std::weak_ptr<scrapeEndpoint> keyed by (canonicalDir, bind_address, stale_ttl) with atomic nextAttempt_/serving_ and try_to_lock reclaim() so destroying the creator agent no longer drops /metrics (#2408), and adds std::optional<std::string> nixl_getenv (56c1c2f706, #2445).
sources.limitations: Cross-process owner death still incurs up to one export + scrape interval gap.

sources.title: Megatron-LM PR #8322, TransformerEngine PR #3638 & TorchTitan PRs #3980/#5390: GDN CUDA Graph State Allocation, JAX MoE FSDP Gated-Shard SwiGLU Fix, RL Pipeline Parallelism, and LoRA TP SPMD Typecheck
sources.publisher: NVIDIA Megatron-LM, TransformerEngine & PyTorch TorchTitan Contributors
sources.notes: Uses value.new_zeros(...) in Megatron GDN for CUDA Graph capture (e592c042d5, #8322), fixes TE JAX MoE FSDP gated-shard SwiGLU layout (2.193176 vs buggy 4.652113) with MeshResource & cuDNN SM100+ GLU fusion (eb3c860a4d, #3638), enables TorchTitan RL Pipeline Parallelism via loss_kwarg_mbs and (pp,dp,cp,tp) Monarch slicing (#3980), and fixes LoRA TP SPMD typechecking via einsum linear rules (a242475253, #5390).
sources.limitations: TorchTitan RL with Context Parallelism or RDMA microbatch transfer under PP remains gated off.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #4905: Integrate TRTLLM-Gen Sliding Window and VariableWindow FMHA (1,424 VariableWindow CUBINs out of 36,964)
sources.notes: Adds TrtllmGenAttentionMaskType::VariableWindow (5) and SlidingWindowCustom (4), preserves Causal fast path when fixedWindowBinds is false (4.2624 us on B300), and fixes mChunkedAttentionSizeLog2 trailing-zero overwrite.
sources.limitations: VariableWindow prefill adds +4.17% on B300 (29.438 -> 30.667 us) and +3.69% on B200 (35.520 -> 36.831 us) at B=8, Q=512, KV=4096.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6947: Cake MiniMax-H3 SM100/SM103 Round-2 Consolidation (+829/-2,598 Lines, 65/65 SASS-Identical CUBINs)
sources.notes: Drops 30 duplicate vendored device-helper headers (904 lines), drops 112 unused macro definitions (224 lines), and extracts 3 shared norm+AdaLN headers (removing 733 duplicated lines) with 65/65 identical cubin SHA-256 and 77/77 bit-exact GPU cells.
sources.limitations: Targets SM100a and SM103a Blackwell targets.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6946: Cake Small GEMMs Consolidation (+2,759/-19,641 Lines across router_gemm, bf16_bmm, and quant_lora_gemm)
sources.notes: Folds 32 router_gemm sources onto 1 body, 32/34 bf16_bmm sources onto 6 bodies, 2 quant_lora_gemm hint kernels onto partner sources, and shares 3 host bindings across 9 LoRA programs (143/143 + 21/21 SASS-identical device rows).
sources.limitations: Two specialized bf16_bmm sources remain distinct where epilogue/pipeline structure diverges.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6938: Cake dense_projection_gemm Consolidation (+2,650/-23,297 Lines across 87 Programs and 104 SM100/SM107 Builds)
sources.notes: Folds 81 duplicate host bindings into 6 shared shape launchers, folds 10 clone kernels into 7 bodies, drops dead SM100 arms from 27 SM107-only kernels, and derives the 84-entry EXPORTED_TEMPLATES union (44 + 54 - 14).
sources.limitations: Targets SM100a (47 builds) and SM107a (57 builds).

sources.title: SGLang PR #45472: Eliminate Host-Device Syncs in Hybrid Mamba Extend Batch Planning and Multimodal Masking
sources.notes: Tracks host-side mamba_ping_pong_empty: list[bool], gathers slots on device via ping_pong_mapping[req_pool_indices, track_positions], uses index_fill_ in clear_slots, and replaces torch.isin with sorted searchsorted + clamp_ + eq.
sources.limitations: Requires keeping mamba_ping_pong_empty synchronized on host slot allocation and release.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45473, #45487 & #45482: FlashInferKDAPrefillGraph CUDA Graph, Host contains_last_prefill_chunk TBO Propagation, and HTTP Worker SO_REUSEPORT
sources.notes: Captures RecurrentKDAPrefillWrapper inside KDAPrefillGraphMetadata on SM100/SM103, computes contains_last_prefill_chunk on CPU and preserves across TBO filter_batch, and adds _ReusePortMultiprocess (--enable-http-worker-reuseport, uvicorn>=0.51) with parent socket reservation.
sources.limitations: SO_REUSEPORT per-worker sockets require Linux kernel support and uvicorn>=0.51.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PR #20734: Fix DeepSeek-V4 _prewarm_cute_dsl_indexer_q Dead Import, PP Stage Filter, and 3-Branch Token Prewarm
sources.notes: Fixes DeepseekV4Indexer import path, filters for local PP stages with wq_b.weight is not None and fused MXFP4 enabled, and prewarms token counts (4, 8, 16) to compile all three _fallback_tactic() branches.
sources.limitations: Applies when CuTe DSL fused MXFP4 indexer projection is enabled on DeepSeek-V4.

sources.title: vLLM PR #57393: Support Cosmos3-Edge ModelOpt Quantized Checkpoints by Dropping Fake Quantizers and Remapping Scales
sources.notes: Drops ModelOpt fake-quantizer state keys (.input_quantizer., .weight_quantizer., .output_quantizer.) and remaps .weight_scale_inv -> .weight_scale and .act_quant_scale -> .input_scale.
sources.limitations: Specific to ModelOpt-calibrated Cosmos3-Edge checkpoint state dicts.

sources.title: vLLM PR #62822, #62825, #62416 & #62824: Rust Frontend Render return_token_ids, Env Vars, CLI Tokenizer/HF-Config Flags, and PromptFillsContext Validation
sources.notes: Splits Ordering::Equal (PromptFillsContext, param='input_tokens') from Ordering::Greater (PromptTooLong), adds return_token_ids to /v1/chat/completions/render, and wires VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL, VLLM_DISABLE_REQUEST_ID_RANDOMIZATION, and --tokenizer/--tokenizer-revision/--hf-config-path.
sources.limitations: Applies to the opt-in Rust HTTP frontend server.

sources.title: TransformerEngine PR #3548 & #3470: KimiDeltaAttention (KDA) cuDNN FROST Module and Narrowed Pre-cuDNN 9.26 THD Learnable-Softmax Guard
sources.notes: Implements KimiDeltaAttention with non-commuting per-key-channel decay S_t = (I - beta_t k_t k_t^T) Diag(exp(g_t)) S_{t-1} + beta_t k_t v_t^T on SM100/SM103/SM107 (head_dim 64, 128) and preserves specialized THD learnable-softmax kernels for head_dim_v in {64, 128, 256} on cuDNN < 9.26.0.
sources.limitations: KDA cuDNN FROST backend requires SM100/SM103/SM107 and head_dim in (64, 128).

sources.title: TorchTitan PR #5548: Use Published rms_norm_eps=1e-5 for Kimi K2.x Decoder-Layer Norms (Fixing 1.0–4.8% Median and 34–40% Max Drift)
sources.notes: Adds norm_eps (default 1e-6 for DeepSeek-V3) to build_mla_moe_layers and passes 1e-5 for Moonlight-16B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B, and Kimi-K2.5 decoder norms while keeping MLA q/kv norms at 1e-6.
sources.limitations: Applies to Kimi flavors built via build_mla_moe_layers.

sources.title: TorchTitan PR #5525 & #5450: Opt-In Cuspy CUPTI Profiler Backend and torch.accelerator Migration for EMA Offload and RL Staging
sources.notes: Adds CuspyProfilerConfig (PM sampling, environment counters, graph dependencies, pftrace output) and replaces hardcoded torch.cuda stream/event calls with torch.accelerator, torch.Stream, and torch.Event.
sources.limitations: Cuspy requires PyTorch >= 2.15 nightly, CUDA 13 driver (R580+), and libcupti >= 13.3.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5925 & #5939 and Dynamo PR #16324: Isolate lmcache.inprocess Namespace and Retire KVBM Crates/Wheels While Keeping dynamo.vllm.pd_connector
sources.notes: Moves deprecated in-process LMCache adapters and standalone starter under lmcache.inprocess and removes 7 kvbm-* crates from Dynamo Cargo.toml and CI wheels while routing PdConnector to dynamo.vllm.pd_connector.
sources.limitations: Legacy kvbm wheels are no longer built or staged in Dynamo release workflows.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4154: TENT Offline Diagnostic Core, CLI11 Version Subcommand, Strict Free-Text Redactor, and 4-Tier Exit Codes
sources.notes: Adds tent diagnostics version [--json] independent of tent_interface, Redactor::sanitizeText() with consistent pseudonyms across fields and logs in strict mode, and exit code precedence 4 (internal) > 3 (collector) > 1 (check fail) > 0.
sources.limitations: Requires system CLI11 headers (libcli11-dev / cli11-devel) when building TENT CLI.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4611: Preserve Integer and Bool Dtypes in Structured Object Store typed_ragged Rows When an Empty List Row Is Present
sources.notes: Ignores empty Python list/tuple rows in _typed_ragged_row_dtypes so NumPy's default float64 dtype on [] does not promote int64 rows (preserving 2**53 + 1 exactness) or misroute bool rows from msgpack_ragged.
sources.limitations: Falls back to all row dtypes only when every row in the field is empty.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6936: Add FP8 PV Support for MiniMax H3 Varlen Attention on SM120/SM121 (1.38x RTX 5090, 1.19x RTX PRO 6000)
sources.notes: Adds standalone V transpose/quantize kernels producing K-major FP8 (e4m3) V + float32 inv_scale, a fourth MMA2 PV loop using mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k32.row.col.f32.e4m3.e4m3.f32, and workspace accounting at 228,440,928 B (64K) and 749,614,176 B (210K).
sources.limitations: Targets SM120 and SM121 Blackwell workstation/consumer GPUs.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6945: Add SM110 Auto Kernel Selection for XQA (pair vs tmem Regimes)
sources.notes: Replaces hardcoded kernel='tmem' with kernel='auto' on SM110 (compute capability (11, 0)), dispatching to 'pair' for non-speculative MHA (group_size==1, q_seq_len==1) and speculative GQA (group_size==8, q_seq_len>1), and 'tmem' otherwise.
sources.limitations: Auto policy is specialized for SM110 (compute capability 11.0).

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6943: Faster sm_107a Rubin Look-Back Mamba2 SSD Kernels (1.0839x Geomean Main Kernel, 1.268x Peak on R200)
sources.notes: Upgrades 6 Rubin (sm_107a) Mamba2 SSD programs with a 2-warp state-passing pass, a single 16-bit chunk-scale header per chunk, and overlapped current-chunk state transport on warp 3, achieving 1.0574x geomean wrapper speedup and 1.0839x geomean main-kernel speedup on R200.
sources.limitations: Targets Rubin sm_107a architecture.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6927: Deslop and Consolidate cake_deepgemm_fp8_gemm (+1,365/-9,927 Lines Across 31 Programs)
sources.notes: Consolidates 31 FP8 x FP8 -> BF16 DeepGEMM programs on SM100a/SM103a onto shared cake_host_common.cuh and 4 device templates (removing 8,562 net lines) while achieving 1.001x geomean throughput on GB300 (5.504-95.137 us).
sources.limitations: Targets SM100a and SM103a Blackwell targets.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6920: Deslop and Consolidate cake_deepgemm_batched_gemm (+1,134/-4,980 Lines Across 19 Programs)
sources.notes: Introduces csrc/include/cake_host_common.cuh and consolidates 19 batched BF16 DeepGEMM programs onto 5 device templates (removing 3,846 net lines) while achieving 1.000x geomean throughput on GB300 (9.727-85.153 us).
sources.limitations: Targets SM100a and SM103a Blackwell targets.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45439: Enforce Free-Before-Walk Ordering and __del__ Tripwire in Unified Radix Tree BaseEvictionResult
sources.notes: Splits BaseEvictionResult.apply() into _free_values (executed first) and _apply_cache_actions (executed second), and adds a __del__ tripwire raising RuntimeError if an unapplied eviction result with pending actions or values is garbage-collected.
sources.limitations: Requires callers of evict() to invoke .apply() on the returned result.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45628: Support DeepSeek-V4.1 Multimodal Vision Token Shard and Unmasked MoE Simulation Mode
sources.notes: Computes token_shard_size = tp_size * dp_size and token_shard_rank = dp_rank * tp_size + tp_rank for vision scatter, avoids masking padded token rows under SGLANG_DEEPEP_MOE_SIMULATION_MODE, and falls back to flash_attn_varlen_func on SM90 when q.shape[2] == 64.
sources.limitations: Simulation mode is intended for synthetic MoE dispatch benchmarking.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PR #20297: Set GEN_ONLY_DEVICE_STEP_TIME_HISTORY_FLOOR_MS = 1790856543000 to Exclude Pre-2026-09-30 TBO Bug History
sources.notes: Adds GEN_ONLY_DEVICE_STEP_TIME_HISTORY_FLOOR_MS = 1790856543000 (2026-09-30T19:42:23Z) to exclude artificially low ~3.3 ms step times caused by a pre-fix TBO timing bug in DeepSeek-R1-0528 FP4 v2 ADP/DEP sanity tests.
sources.limitations: Applies to gen_only_device_step_time metric history filtering.

sources.title: vLLM PR #62859: Reject Multimodal Inputs in Chunked-Processing Path via VLLMValidationError
sources.notes: Raises VLLMValidationError in maybe_pre_process_chunked when any prompt is a dict containing multi_modal_data rather than silently dropping multimodal payloads.
sources.limitations: Multimodal inputs must use the standard non-chunked preprocessing entrypoint.

sources.title: vLLM PR #62244: Fix estimate_mm_memory Cleanup Crash on Non-CUDA Platforms via current_platform.empty_cache()
sources.notes: Replaces hardcoded torch.cuda.empty_cache() with current_platform.empty_cache() in estimate_mm_memory finally block so Intel XPU and other non-CUDA backends clean up without crashing.
sources.limitations: Requires platform backend to implement empty_cache().

sources.title: vLLM PR #62823: Align Rust Frontend response_format vs Top-Level Guided Decoding Precedence with Python
sources.notes: Runs convert_from_response_format before top-level json_schema/regex/grammar/choice and uses get_or_insert_with(Default::default) so top-level fields override response_format while preserving structural_tag.
sources.limitations: Applies to the Rust HTTP frontend server.

sources.title: TransformerEngine PR #3680: Port Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) Triton Kernels to JAX (20-Iter Log-Space Sinkhorn)
sources.notes: Ports mHC Triton kernels to TE/JAX via jax_triton.triton_call with N_STREAMS=4, N_MIX=24, 16-byte alignment (C % 8 == 0 for BF16/FP16), 20-iteration log-space Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization, and a two-stage atomic-free backward reduction.
sources.limitations: Requires hidden dimension C to be 16-byte aligned.

sources.title: TransformerEngine PR #3639: Migrate JAX Fused MoE EP to ncclEpImportHandle v2 and Disable Stale Handle Cache by Default
sources.notes: Replaces ncclEpCreateGroup with ncclEpImportHandle under NCCL_EP_VERSION >= 2, defaults NVTE_EP_HANDLE_CACHE_SIZE to 0 so handles are destroyed after each collective, and routes max_tokens_per_rank via NVTE_FUSED_MOE_EP_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK.
sources.limitations: Requires NCCL EP version >= 2 for ncclEpImportHandle.

sources.title: Megatron-LM PR #7494: Add VMM Allocation Mode with FABRIC -> POSIX_FD Fallback to NCCL MemPool Allocator
sources.notes: Adds vmm=True to create_nccl_mem_pool via custom C++ VMM allocator trying CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC (MNNVL) and falling back to CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_POSIX_FD_DESCRIPTOR on PCIe/single-node systems when cuMemCreate returns CUDA_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED or CUDA_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED.
sources.limitations: Requires CUDA driver VMM support and 2 MiB granularity rounding.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5805 & #5946: Add 5 MP Lifecycle Plugin Hooks and Fix Non-Zero skip_first_n_tokens Retrieve Bitmask Padding
sources.notes: Adds ON_MP_SERVER_START/STOP, ON_MP_REQUEST_PREPROCESS, ON_MP_DISK_PREFETCH_FINISHED, and ON_MP_LOCK_MISMATCH hooks, and prepends [None] * num_to_skip_blocks in retrieve() so returned bitmask length equals total_blocks.
sources.limitations: Applies to LMCache multiprocess mode.

sources.title: Dynamo PR #16742 & #13744 and NIXL PR #2479: FPM Init GIL Release, Carrier-Free DGDR v1beta2, and NIXL xfer_request_id / xfer_execution Telemetry
sources.read_scope: dynamo FPM bindings, deploy/operator/api/v1beta2/, and nixl src/core/nixl_agent.cpp
sources.notes: Releases Python GIL via py.allow_threads during ForwardPassMetrics init, migrates DynamoGraphDeploymentRequest to carrier-free v1beta2 with lossless Hub conversion, and adds 64-bit xfer_request_id and per-repost xfer_execution counters to NIXL.
sources.limitations: NIXL telemetry events require NIXL_TELEMETRY_ENABLE=y.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4756: Support Ascend Direct Transport Host-Memory Sharing via mmap/memfd_create and SharedHostMapper Address Rebasing
sources.notes: Enables same-node host DRAM zero-copy sharing on Ascend A5 without HCCS by exporting memfd descriptors over Unix SCM_RIGHTS and rebasing remote virtual addresses via SharedHostMapper: local_addr + (target_addr - seg_base).
sources.limitations: Requires same-node shared host memory (shm_fd >= 0).

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6877: Self-Contained SM90 cake_vsa_sm90 Backend Package with 17 BF16 Small and Persistent Kernels (119/137 Rows Faster on H100)
sources.notes: Packages 17 BF16 SM90 VSA programs (attention static persistent, attention_queue dynamic queue, and 15 small direct/DSM-cluster/split-KV/split-cluster kernels), achieving 1.0205x (b20), 1.0515x (ext33, up to 1.2524x), 1.0367x (real39, up to 1.2126x), and 1.0120x (long45) geomean speedup on H100 SXM 80GB.
sources.limitations: Targets Hopper sm_90a BF16 Video Sparse Attention.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #5743: Add PowLU Activation to the CUTLASS Fused-MoE Backend with Zero-ABI-Breakage Parameter Reuse
sources.notes: Implements PowLU(g) = g > 0 ? g^(m / (sqrt(g) + 1)) * sigmoid(g) : g * sigmoid(g) and gated clamp min(PowLU(gate), limit) * clamp(up, -limit, limit) with DEFAULT_POWLU_M = 2.5 (peak 4.02 at m=2.5, 7.02 at m=3.5), reusing swiglu_alpha and swiglu_limit in ActivationParams.
sources.limitations: Applies to the CUTLASS fused-MoE backend.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6888 & #6887: Vendorable SM90a/SM100a/SM103a cake_fused_qk_rope_fp8_append and cake_fused_qk_rope_append Kernels (Up to 1.1428x Geomean on GB300)
sources.notes: Delivers self-contained fused QK-RoPE + KV-append packages across H100/H200/B200/B300/GB300, reaching 1.0328x-1.0442x FP8 geomean across 220 rows (all >= 1.00x) and 1.0623x-1.1428x BF16 geomean across 140 rows (139/140 >= 1.00x).
sources.limitations: Targets sm_90a, sm_100a, and sm_103a.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6122 & #6684: Whole-Tile Static One-Wave SM100a/SM103a DCP Decode (1.240x GB300) and SM120 MegaMoE part002 Deduplication
sources.notes: Adds static one-wave programs 2..5 for dcp_spec_bf16_balanced (1.138x on GB300, 11.07 -> 9.73 us) and program 2 for dcp_spec_bf16_fp8_d256_balanced (1.240x on GB300, 17.02 -> 13.73 us), and removes the duplicate 1,090-line part002.cuh in SM120 MegaMoE with 18 verified manifest seals.
sources.limitations: One-wave DCP targets SM100a/SM103a; MegaMoE part001 reuse targets SM120.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45519: Set MOONCAKE_DISABLE_HIP_DMABUF=1 on AMD MI35x (gfx950) Disaggregation to Fix Stream Creation OOM Crash
sources.notes: Automatically sets MOONCAKE_DISABLE_HIP_DMABUF=1 on gfx950 (MI350X/MI355X) so Mooncake registers KV cache via ibv_reg_mr instead of hipMemGetHandleForAddressRange dmabuf, avoiding ROCm stream creation segfaults.
sources.limitations: Applies to AMD gfx950 (MI35x) ROCm disaggregated deployments.

sources.title: SGLang PR #43941 & #43698: Whole-Number Float String Coercion for Integer Tool Parameters and Flux DiT ComfyUI ControlNet SP Residual Sharding
sources.notes: Coerces whole-number float strings ('3.0' -> 3, '1e2' -> 100) for integer tool parameters when math.isfinite(f) and f.is_integer(), and deduplicates/shards ComfyUI ControlNet residuals across Flux DiT sequence-parallel ranks.
sources.limitations: Fractional strings ('3.5') and non-finite strings ('inf', 'NaN') remain uncoerced.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PR #20387 & #20253: Support FP8 Custom-Mask Context Attention in TritonCustomMaskFmha and Remove Obsolete Warmup Switches
sources.notes: Enables FP8 KV cache and float8_e4m3fn output in TritonCustomMaskFmha via tile-level (k.to(fp32) * kv_scale).to(q.dtype) dequantization without allocating a BF16 KV pool copy and [-448.0, 448.0] output clamping, while PR #20253 removes prepare_resource and redundant max_spec_graph capture.
sources.limitations: Custom-mask Triton attention rejects INT8 and NVFP4 KV caches.

sources.title: vLLM PR #62822, #62825 & #62416: Propagate return_token_ids, Guard VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL at 1ns Floor, and Support --tokenizer / --hf-config-path in Rust CLI
sources.notes: Threads return_token_ids through Rust render_chat/render_completion, guards VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL with interval.max(Duration::from_nanos(1)) alongside VLLM_DISABLE_REQUEST_ID_RANDOMIZATION, and promotes --tokenizer, --tokenizer-revision, and --hf-config-path into ModelArgs::file_sources().
sources.limitations: Applies to the vLLM Rust frontend and CLI.

sources.title: TransformerEngine PR #3670, #3671 & #3606: Zero-Storage torch._efficientzerotensor Dummy wgrad, NaN-Safe TP parallel_cross_entropy Argmax, and GroupedLinear Backward Refactor
sources.notes: Adds zero_tensor_dummy_wgrad via torch._efficientzerotensor cached by (*shape, dtype, str(device)), implements NaN-safe tie-breaking return_argmax=True in parallel_cross_entropy across TP shards, and extracts shared backward_objects state for GroupedLinear.
sources.limitations: zero_tensor_dummy_wgrad is used when in-place zeroing of the dummy buffer is not required.

sources.title: TorchTitan PR #5394 & #5501: Optimizer-Owned Configurable GradientClipper and _HuggingFaceCursorIterator._pending_hf_state Preservation
sources.notes: Extracts GradientClipper(Configurable) owned by Optim and shared with TorchFTOptim, and caches restored HF cursor bytes in _pending_hf_state until __next__ yields a row so pre-read packer checkpoints do not save stale dataset positions.
sources.limitations: _pending_hf_state works around lazy load_state_dict() application in datasets.IterableDataset.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5803 & #5903: Add server_module_affinity_call for Client-Affinity Plugins and Ban New Pickle Imports via Ruff TID251
sources.notes: Adds requires_client_affinity=True and server_module_affinity_call so layer-wise KV retrieval plugins execute in order on the client's affinity thread, and bans pickle imports (TID251) while renaming pickled_payload to descriptor_payload.
sources.limitations: Affinity handlers block subsequent store/retrieve calls on the same client thread until they return.

sources.title: Dynamo PR #16974: Set 2-Second pool_idle_timeout on SGLang Native HTTP Client to Preempt 5-Second Server Keep-Alive Closure
sources.notes: Configures reqwest::Client::builder().pool_idle_timeout(Duration::from_secs(2)) in build_http_client so Dynamo retires idle HTTP connections before SGLang's default 5s keep-alive closes them.
sources.limitations: Applies to Dynamo's Rust SGLang native HTTP sidecar client.

sources.title: NIXL PR #2327: Run the CPU Proxy Over UCX via nixl::ucx::proxyEngine, Per-(Channel, Peer) Ring Workers, and Fenced UCP_ATOMIC_OP_ADD
sources.notes: Introduces nixl::ucx::proxyEngine (device_proxy=true) partitioning shared UCX workers one per (channel, peer) ring, fencing the worker before ucp_atomic_op_nbx(UCP_ATOMIC_OP_ADD), and enforcing NIXL_THREAD_SYNC_RW and ucx_error_handling_mode=none.
sources.limitations: Requires hardware NIC atomic support on target memory; software atomic fallback on GPU memory is unsupported.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4622: Reject Weight Registration Leases From Another Store Without Consuming Original Lease
sources.notes: Checks pre_registered_lease._owner is not self in registered() and raises WeightStoreError('registration lease belongs to a different Store') before mutating or consuming the lease.
sources.limitations: Applies to mooncake-reshard weight store upload and load paths.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4688: Snapshot File Birth Times Before Reconstructing Eviction Order in FileUtil::SortByCreationTime
sources.notes: Snapshots statx STATX_BTIME into TimeKey{!has_birth_time, seconds, nanoseconds} before std::sort so disappearing files do not violate strict weak ordering inside the comparator.
sources.limitations: Files without birth times sort last, tie-broken by path.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4673 & #4755: Opt-In Same-Cycle Partial SSD Bucket Flush (MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_FLUSH_PARTIAL_BUCKETS) and Validated DFS Shard Cache Fast-Path
sources.notes: Adds MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_FLUSH_PARTIAL_BUCKETS=1 to flush trailing partial buckets within the current offload cycle while source replicas are pinned, and reuses cached DFS ShardFile descriptors without normalization when shard->fd >= 0 && shard->path == descriptor.file_path.
sources.limitations: Changed or aliased DFS paths still run full lexically_normal() validation without reopening the fd.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6954: Per-Architecture (sm_100a/sm_103a/sm_107a) Programs (_rso, _rst, _qp, _sop, _pf) and Permuted Pass-1 Sum of Squares for NVFP4-Transport All-Reduce + RMSNorm
sources.notes: Ships 37 programs (20 per arch across sm_100a, sm_103a, sm_107a) for NVFP4-transport all-reduce + RMSNorm, reaching 1.0718x geomean on B200 (1.0942x peak at 8K x 6144 NVFP4 -> NVFP4: 77.36 -> 70.70 us).
sources.limitations: Packed two-wide quantization (_qp) is enabled on sm_100a and sm_103a but omitted on sm_107a where scalar quantization remains faster.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6818: Cast to FP32 Before Squaring in MNNVL One-Shot Fused All-Reduce + RMSNorm to Prevent FP16 Overflow
sources.notes: Fixes oneshot_allreduce_fusion_kernel by converting toFloat<T>(packedAccum.elements[i]) before squaring so FP16 activations with |x| > 255.94 do not overflow to inf and zero out rsqrtf(inf), restoring Qwen3.5-27B FP16 TP=2 RL validation score from 0.000 to 0.698.
sources.limitations: Applies to MNNVL one-shot fused allreduce + RMSNorm (two-shot already squared in float).

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6872: Faster Single-Launch SM100/SM103 Sage-FP8 Block-Sparse Attention (1.30x-1.40x) and Fused Quantizers (1.23x)
sources.notes: Replaces descriptor upload + kernel launch with a single launch on SM100/SM103 (1.30x-1.40x faster on GB300 across S_q=S_k=4096) and speeds up fused quantize_qk_vamax + quantize_v by 1.23x (0.2610 -> 0.2127 ms).
sources.limitations: Targets head_dim=128 with 64x64 block-sparse tiles and Sage-FP8 E4M3 quantization.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6825: trtllm_fused_moe_workspace_size Query and Caller-Owned workspace_buffer Reuse (-2,683.1 MiB on B300)
sources.notes: Adds query_workspace_size dry-run mode and caller-owned workspace_buffer= parameter across 11 quantization modes, cutting B300 autotuning peak memory on 16384x7168 (E=256, top-8) from 3,579.9 MiB to 896.8 MiB (-74.95%).
sources.limitations: Caller workspace must be uint8 CUDA tensor sized to the maximum across queried tactics.

sources.title: FlashInfer PRs #6898 & #6879: SM120 MegaMoE Duplicate part002.cuh Removal and Kimi-K3 NVFP4 SiTU 103-Helper Header Folding (-17,018 Lines)
sources.notes: Drops duplicate 1,090-line SM120 part002.cuh with 18 re-sealed digests (#6898) and extracts 103 guarded device helpers, folds fc1:n8_s2a, and shares 8 host bindings in Kimi-K3 SiTU (#6879), reducing 75,311 lines to 58,293 (-17,018 lines) with identical SASS.
sources.limitations: Compile-time helper inclusion is controlled via #define CAKE_SITU_NEED_<HELPER> before including cake_kimi_k3_nvfp4_situ_device.cuh.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45630: Lower DeepSeek-V4.1 MXFP8 Autotune Minimum Tokens from 4096 to 1 to Enable Tuned Tactics at Decode Sizes
sources.notes: Changes mxfp8_prefill_autotune_min_tokens from 4096 to 1 when FlashInfer CuTeDSL and block_fp8_as_mxfp8 are active, unlocking tuned MXFP8 tactics across all 14/14 decode and prefill token buckets.
sources.limitations: Deterministic inference mode continues to pin tactic -1.

sources.title: SGLang PR #43698: Apply ControlNet Double/Single-Block Residuals in ComfyUI Flux Integrated Mode with Identity Deduplication and SP Sharding
sources.notes: Preserves shared ControlNet residual object identity across _slice_batch_row (_memo), _pack_control (detached), and prepare_control_residual_kwargs (prepared + shard_latents_for_sp), cutting IPC pickle and SP sharding overhead by 5.7x across 57 Flux blocks while adding comfyui_control to _SESSION_SKIP_EXTRA.
sources.limitations: Control residuals are per-step tensors and intentionally excluded from cross-step session caching.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PRs #20043 & #20612: Remove 35 Legacy Executor MpiTag Entries & Compatibility Files and Align Nightly Release BOLT Pipeline
sources.notes: Retires 35 legacy executor MpiTag enum entries and 6 compatibility files (#20043), and sets ENABLE_BOLT_PREMERGE_CONSUME = true while publishing the BOLT variant alongside the uninstrumented profile-input tarball on nightly release (#20612).
sources.limitations: Breaking C++ removal for out-of-tree callers referencing retired MpiTag enum values.

sources.title: vLLM PRs #61391, #62879 & #62893: BERT TokenClassificationHeadWithLoRA + AllPool Slicing, Shared-GPU NIXL Prefill-First Barrier, and ROCm EAGLE3 Batch Invariance
sources.notes: Adds TokenClassificationHeadWithLoRA and AllPool(output_sizes_fn) to slice per-request token logits hs[:, :size] (#61391), serializes NIXL decoder launch behind prefiller readiness when GPUS_NEEDED > num_gpus (#62879), and sets VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 for ROCm EAGLE3 accuracy (#62893).
sources.limitations: Token classification LoRA adapters require max_lora_cls_labels >= max adapter num_labels.

sources.title: TransformerEngine PRs #3584 & #3659: GroupedLinear split_alignment Automatic CuTeDSL GroupedMLP Fusion and 0-D Scalar Scale Fake-Tensor Metadata for ONNX FP8
sources.notes: Deprecates NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP and enables automatic GroupedMLP_CuTeGEMMGLU fusion when split_alignment=256 (BF16/FP16) or 128 (MXFP8/NVFP4/FP8 block scaling) (#3584), and fixes onnx_cs_quantize_fp8_op fake tensor scale shape to 0-D () (#3659).
sources.limitations: Emits a warning if Sequential(GroupedLinear, ScaledSwiGLU, GroupedLinear) misses fusion solely due to insufficient split_alignment.

sources.title: Megatron-LM PR #8211: Migrate Optimizer & Param Scheduler Configuration to SchedulerConfig and PretrainConfigContainer
sources.notes: Consolidates iteration-based and sample-based LR warmup/decay/WSD step derivation into PretrainConfigContainer._resolve_scheduler_step_fields() and SchedulerConfig.validate_run().
sources.limitations: Checkpoint scheduler overrides are now governed by cfg.scheduler.override_opt_param_scheduler and use_checkpoint_opt_param_scheduler.

sources.title: TorchTitan PRs #5528 & #5500: Llama-3.2 1B/3B RoPE scaling_factor=32.0 Fix and Per-Module _MissingKernel Subclasses for Attention Gym
sources.notes: Sets scaling_factor=32.0 on Llama-3.2 1B and 3B flavors (eliminating 17/32 and 35/64 frequency mismatches, 0.781 rad angle error at pos 8192, and cutting max logit diff from 3.2e-4 to 7e-7) (#5528), and creates per-module _MissingKernel[<module>] subclasses with require_attn_gym(*kernels) (#5500).
sources.limitations: Existing Llama-3.2 checkpoints trained with scaling_factor=8.0 experienced up to 4x RoPE frequency drift on low/medium wavelengths.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5950: Consolidate CreateTransferChannel, NixlChannel, and PySocketChannel Under lmcache.inprocess.v1.transfer_channel
sources.notes: Moves legacy transfer_channel implementations into lmcache.inprocess.v1.transfer_channel and removes the top-level lmcache.v1.transfer_channel package.
sources.limitations: Internal imports across cache_controller, gpu_connector, nixl_storage_agent, and P2P backend must reference lmcache.inprocess.v1.transfer_channel.

sources.title: AI-Dynamo PR #16759: Forward stop_token_ids_visible in SGLang and TensorRT-LLM Sidecars to Preserve Tool-Call Delimiters
sources.notes: Merges stop_token_ids_visible into stop_token_ids in SGLang (return_text=None) and TRT-LLM (include_stop_in_output=Some(true) + ResponseState buffered_hidden_stop_tokens), preserving visible stop delimiters such as <|call|>.
sources.limitations: TRT-LLM sidecar buffers hidden stop tokens until finish_reason == stop confirms termination.

sources.title: NIXL PR #2328: Expert-Parallel (nixl_ep) Over 8-Channel / 8-Thread CPU Proxy (FENCE_MODE=ep_based) Reaching 100%-109% of Direct GPU RDMA
sources.notes: Adds NIXL_EP_DEVICE_MODE=proxy with 8 channels and 8 NUMA-pinned proxy threads (FENCE_MODE=ep_based), reaching 59.0 GB/s (103% of direct) on 2x H100, 45.5 GB/s (104%) on 4x H100, 41.6 GB/s (100%) on 8x H100, and 53.3 GB/s (109%) on 2x GB200.
sources.limitations: Oversubscribing spinning proxy threads (e.g. 16 threads/GPU across 4 GPUs on a 32-core NUMA node) collapses throughput to 1.2 GB/s (3%).

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4651: ConductorClient C ABI (conductor_c.h) and Safe Thread-Safe Rust Crate (mooncake-conductor/rust)
sources.notes: Exposes ConductorClient via a 10-function C ABI (conductor_c.h) with 7 negative error codes (-600 to -2001) and wraps it in a Send + Sync Rust crate linked against libconductor_cpp_core.a.
sources.limitations: Requires build-time CMake compilation of conductor_cpp_core static library via build.rs.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6770: [SM120] MegaMoE register spill with CUDA 13.3 headers; compile-check every EP
sources.notes: Eliminates CUDA 13.2-13.4 register spills across 1,440 SM120 MegaMoE JIT instances per toolkit via _CCCL_ATOMIC_UNSAFE_AUTOMATIC_STORAGE, per-GIN backend modules, m128 1-step K loop, tb_pub workspace above 16 ranks, and 15-bit ACTIVE_ROWS_FIELD_MAX=0x7FFF (32640 rows).
sources.limitations: Targets SM120a MXFP4/MXFP8/BF16 Cake MegaMoE kernels with NCCL GIN backends.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6331: opt-in multi-wave KV split for decode when one wave gives <= 2 splits
sources.notes: Adds FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_GEN_MULTI_WAVE_KV_SPLIT=1 (kMaxNumWavesForKvSplit=4) for GQA decode when single-wave splits <= 2, achieving 1.86x geomean speedup on B200 64k lognormal and 2.02x peak at B=38 288k lognormal (1566 -> 775 us).
sources.limitations: Opt-in via environment variable; applies to non-MLA GQA decode when single-wave splits <= 2.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6902: ship the experimental NVFP4 attention as a self-contained vendorable package
sources.notes: Packages SM103a persistent-tile NVFP4 attention (HEAD_DIM=128, SF_VEC=16, TILE_ROWS=512, E2M1_BOUNDARIES) as a self-contained cake-build/1 package with 0.9975x GB300 geomean parity.
sources.limitations: Targets SM103a (Blackwell Ultra B300/GB300) NVFP4 attention.

sources.title: TensorRT-LLM PR #20575: Encode VisualGen video without a GIL-held frame copy
sources.notes: Replaces video_np.tobytes() with memoryview(video_np.reshape(-1)) in encode_video, eliminating a 711.91 MiB host buffer allocation and GIL-held frame copy for 120-frame 1080p RGB video.
sources.limitations: Applies to host numpy frame buffers piped to ffmpeg stdin.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45579: [dsv4] Precompute WindowLayout history_src once per batch
sources.notes: Precomputes WindowLayout.history_src once per batch in build_window_layout() and applies layer-specific pad slots via masked_fill, cutting 2D fancy-indexing across 60 layers by 60x (60 -> 1).
sources.limitations: Applies when max_hist > 0 in DeepSeek-V4.1 window layouts.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45577: [dsv4] Cache V4.1 prefill index-k gather and plans per ratio
sources.notes: Caches low_ratio_k_slots and low_ratio_index_plans per compression ratio (r in {4, 8}) on DSV4Metadata, reducing index-k gathers and FastIndexPlan builds across 48 low-ratio layers by 24x (48 -> 2).
sources.limitations: Relies on request-window left bounds and history lengths being multiples of r.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45573: [dsv4] Restore sparse prefill when request window is active
sources.notes: Removes the erroneous window_layout is None requirement on use_sparse_prefill so long-context extend batches with an active request window take the sparse context stage.
sources.limitations: Applies when max_total_seq_len >= sparse_prefill_threshold.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45575: [dsv4] Keep vision_topk off packed-ids under routing simulation
sources.notes: Gates DeepseekV4MoEGate.enable_packed_ids on not RoutingSimulationConfig.is_enabled() so FunctionOverrideRouter overrides on topk_ids are respected by FlashInfer cutlass_fused_moe.
sources.limitations: Applies when SGLANG_MOE_ROUTING_SIMULATION_STRATEGY is active.

sources.title: SGLang PR #45559: [RadixCache] Order cache linker offloads behind forward stream
sources.notes: Orders UnifiedCacheLinker (MooncakeDirectLinker, UMBPDirectLinker) offloads behind both current_stream and an _offload_ready_event recorded on forward_stream, preventing premature KV copy under overlap scheduling.
sources.limitations: Applies to asynchronous cache linker offload paths (offload_synchronize=False).

sources.title: vLLM PR #52780: [MoE] Support simulated routing in monolithic MoE backends
sources.notes: Adds kernel_routing_method_type, supports_monolithic_kernels, and prepare_monolithic_bias() so monolithic TRTLLM MoE kernels support DeepSeekV3 LoadBalanced bias injection while rejecting unsupported custom simulators in favor of decomposed modular MoE.
sources.limitations: Monolithic kernels only support static bias simulation (moe_backend_LoadBalanced).

sources.title: Megatron-LM PR #8353: fix(inference): model GDN prefill CUDA graph as single-update GDP
sources.notes: Models Gated DeltaNet (GDN) prefill CUDA graph static cu_seqlens buffers as a single-update Generalized Delta Product (num_householder=1, GDP_CHUNK_SIZE=64).
sources.limitations: Applies to GDN prefill CUDA graph capture and replay in dynamic inference context.

sources.title: TorchTitan PR #5394: Move gradient clipping into OptimizersContainer as a GradientClipper component
sources.notes: Moves clip_grad_norm_ into OptimizersContainer as a first-class GradientClipper invoked inside the optimizer _update hook, shared seamlessly with TorchFT FTManager.
sources.limitations: Requires GradientClipper config attached to OptimizersContainer.

sources.title: TorchTitan PR #5390: Fix LoRA compatibility with SPMD type checking under TP
sources.notes: Delegates _LinearFunction.spmd_typecheck to einsum('...k,nk->...n') bilinearity rules so Partial activations from lora_a multiply cleanly with Replicate lora_b weights under TP.
sources.limitations: Applies to DTensor SPMD typechecking of LoRA linear layers under Tensor Parallelism.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5889: perf(mp): replace fixed max-in-flight with dynamic staging memory watermark for L2 prefetch
sources.notes: Replaces fixed max_in_flight=8 with --l2-prefetch-inflight-watermark (default 0.5), raising 8 MiB prefetch concurrency by 4.0x (32 vs 8) on a 1 GiB pool while bounding 128 MiB prefetches to 512 MiB.
sources.limitations: Applies to multiprocessing L2 prefetch staging pools.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5855: fix: register dim-0-padded KV pools in VmmCudaIPCWrapper
sources.notes: Computes total byte span of VMM-backed KV tensors via 1 + sum((shape[i]-1)*stride[i]) instead of numel(), properly mapping dim-0-padded vLLM cross-layer uniform KV pools (e.g., 3584 B vs 2048 B).
sources.limitations: Applies to CUDA VMM IPC registration of strided/padded KV pools.

sources.title: LMCache PR #5929: fix(c_ops): ensure primary CUDA context on current thread in stream_ops
sources.notes: Retains and binds the primary CUDA context via cuDevicePrimaryCtxRetain + cuCtxSetCurrent before cuStreamWaitValue64 / cuStreamWriteValue64 on fresh OS worker threads.
sources.limitations: Applies to CUDA Driver API stream memory operations in c_ops.

sources.title: Mooncake PR #4410: Allow CPU clients to select peer GPU TCP memory
sources.notes: Enables caps.dram_to_gpu and caps.gpu_to_dram whenever TCP transport is installed so CPU-only clients can transfer directly to/from remote peer GPU TCP memory segments.
sources.limitations: Applies to Mooncake TransferEngine TCP transport topology selection.

sources.title: NIXL PR #2479: feat(telemetry): add xfer request ID and execution counter to transfer requests
sources.notes: Adds an atomic 64-bit unsigned decimal nixl.xfer_request_id at handle creation and increments nixl.xfer_execution on each postXferReq invocation.
sources.limitations: Process-scoped 64-bit request ID counter.

sources.title: Dynamo PR #16947: fix(multimodal): propagate errors in count_all_image_tokens
sources.notes: Changes count_all_image_tokens to return Result<usize> and propagates decode/shape errors so preprocessor logs a warning and sets image_tokens = None instead of bogus Some(0).
sources.limitations: Applies to Rust multimodal preprocessor image token accounting.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6904: round-2 Kimi-K3 AttnRes routes and programs for SM100 / SM103 as a vendorable cake-build package
sources.notes: Packages 133 Kimi-K3 AttnRes programs (161 libraries: 75 sm_100a, 86 sm_103a) under cake-build/1 with 1.0072x GB300 geomean across 582 rows, 1.0888x on serving_m5_k5, and 1.1034x on B200 k_sweep_m1_k6.
sources.limitations: Targets SM100a (B200) and SM103a (B300/GB300) BF16 H=7168, K in 0..8.

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6876: deslop(cake_kda_tf32): dead host code, one device-helper header, 24 kernel clones folded onto 9 bodies

sources.title: FlashInfer PR #6862: deslop(cake_fp8_gemm): table-driven batch routing, shared headers, mxfp8 and grouped source folds, dead host text

sources.limitations: First-hand upstream commit audit and deterministic model verification.
